notes:
Chaos Arena. Its seventeen structures -- the Chaos Citadel, four Relay Bunkers and twelve Border Stations -- are now reinforceable by name, id or coordinates, the same as the Baron wonders. Verified against the game screen: Border Station 10 is where the table puts it.

Two fixes to 1.0.7.3. WondersInformation is keyed by UiIndex, not by the wonder id; the two are equal for ids 1-38 so the Baron names were right by luck, and the arena had no names at all. And the wrong-kingdom guard was a range check that would have refused every arena structure -- it now asks which set a wonder belongs to and applies that set's rule, using the engine's own IsPVPKingdom for the arena.
